A '''model''' of repulsorcraft vehicle was used by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] in [[1 BBY]]. Several of these vehicles were blown up by [[Kleya Marki]] as a distraction for her [[Infiltration of Lina Soh Hospital|infiltration of the Lina Soh Hospital]].<ref name="Make It Stop">{{Andor|Make It Stop}}</ref> Following the bombing, ISB supervisor [[Avril Heert]] travelled in the same model of transport to [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], where the [[Axis network]] [[Fractal radio]] was being examined.<ref name="Episode">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}</ref>
